aerodynamics.name: GT Wing (Large)
aerodynamics.description: Large adjustable carbon fiber rear wing mounted on stands. Adds significant downforce. Common on time attack and track cars.
aerodynamics.visual_change: Adds a prominent rear wing elevated ~2 bricks above the trunk, with visible endplates. Transforms the car's rear profile dramatically.

aerodynamics.name: Ducktail Spoiler
aerodynamics.description: Subtle upward-angled lip spoiler integrated into the trunk edge. Classic Porsche and JDM style.
aerodynamics.visual_change: Adds a subtle kicked-up lip at the trunk edge. Understated but recognizable to car enthusiasts.

aerodynamics.name: Front Splitter
aerodynamics.real_world_ref: APR Front Wind Splitter / Racebred Splitter
aerodynamics.description: Flat carbon fiber panel extending forward from the front bumper. Reduces lift by managing airflow under the car.
aerodynamics.visual_change: Extends the front bumper lower with a flat blade. Gives the car a more aggressive, track-focused stance.

aerodynamics.name: Rear Diffuser
aerodynamics.real_world_ref: Voltex Rear Diffuser / Top Secret Diffuser
aerodynamics.description: Multi-fin rear underbody panel that accelerates airflow, creating a low-pressure zone for downforce.
aerodynamics.visual_change: Adds a technical-looking finned panel under the rear bumper. Visible from behind the car.

aerodynamics.name: Front Canards (Dive Planes)
aerodynamics.description: Small winglets on the front bumper corners that generate front downforce and direct airflow around the wheels.
aerodynamics.visual_change: Adds small protruding fins at the front corners. Subtle but authentic motorsport detail.

wheels_stance.name: Deep Dish Wheels
wheels_stance.real_world_ref: Work Meister S1 / BBS LM / Volk TE37
wheels_stance.description: Wider wheels with deep lip/concave face. Classic JDM and Euro style. Often paired with stretched tires.
wheels_stance.visual_change: Wider rear wheels with deep concave look. More aggressive stance. Staggered fitment like real sports cars.

wheels_stance.name: Off-Road / Rally Wheels
wheels_stance.real_world_ref: Method Race Wheels / Enkei RPF1 (gravel spec)
wheels_stance.description: Chunky tires with aggressive tread pattern. Raised ride height. Common on rally and overland builds.
wheels_stance.visual_change: Much larger diameter wheels with chunky tread. Noticeably lifted ride height. Rally/mud terrain stance.

wheels_stance.name: Negative Camber (Stanced)
wheels_stance.description: Wheels tilted inward at the top (negative camber). Extreme version is 'stanced' look popular in JDM and VIP scenes.
wheels_stance.visual_change: Wheels visibly tilted inward. Very distinctive 'stanced' look. Fans will recognize this immediately.

wheels_stance.name: Wheel Spacers (Wider Track)
wheels_stance.description: Pushes wheels outward for a wider stance and flush fitment with fenders.
wheels_stance.visual_change: Wheels sit more flush with fenders. Subtle but important for car stance.

exhaust.name: Titanium Burnt-Tip Exhaust
exhaust.real_world_ref: HKS Hi-Power / GReddy Ti-C / Tomei Expreme
exhaust.description: Large diameter single or dual exhaust with signature blue/purple burnt titanium tip. Iconic JDM look.
exhaust.visual_change: Large circular exhaust tip with distinctive blue/purple coloring at the tip. Classic JDM rear view.

exhaust.name: Center-Exit Exhaust
exhaust.real_world_ref: Porsche 911 GT3 center exhaust / Lotus Evora
exhaust.description: Exhaust exits through the center of the rear diffuser instead of corners. Race-derived layout.
exhaust.visual_change: Exhaust moves from corners to center. Clean, modern rear appearance. Motorsport-derived look.

exhaust.name: Side-Exit Exhaust
exhaust.real_world_ref: RWB side exhaust / Dodge Viper ACR
exhaust.description: Exhaust exits from the side of the car, usually just behind the front wheel or before the rear wheel.
exhaust.visual_change: Exhaust visible on the side of the car. Very aggressive, race-car look. Unmistakable to enthusiasts.

body_kits.name: Wide Body / Overfenders
body_kits.description: Bolt-on flared fenders extending beyond the stock body width. Exposed rivets/bolts. The defining look of the 'widebody' movement.
body_kits.visual_change: Dramatically wider fenders with visible bolt/rivet detail. Significantly changes the car's side profile and stance. The signature 'widebody' look.

body_kits.name: Aggressive Front Bumper
body_kits.description: Large-mouth front bumper with integrated splitter, larger air intakes, and more aggressive angles.
body_kits.visual_change: Larger, more aggressive front end with bigger air intakes. Lower front lip. Transforms the car's 'face'.

body_kits.name: Side Skirts
body_kits.description: Extended lower panels running along the sides between front and rear wheels. Visually lowers the car.
body_kits.visual_change: Clean line running along the lower body sides. Makes the car look lower and more planted.

interior.name: Roll Cage (6-Point)
interior.description: Full welded roll cage visible through windows. Required for serious track cars.
interior.visual_change: Visible safety cage structure through the windows. Instantly recognizable as a track/race car interior.

interior.name: Racing Bucket Seats
interior.real_world_ref: Bride Zeta III / Recaro SPG / Sparco Evo
interior.description: Deep bolstered fixed-back racing seats with harness holes. Replace stock seats.
interior.visual_change: Visible racing seats through windows. Distinctive reclined bucket shape.

lighting.name: LED Daytime Running Lights
lighting.real_world_ref: Audi-style LED DRL / Morimoto XSB switchback
lighting.description: Bright LED light strips in the front bumper or headlights. Modern premium car signature.
lighting.visual_change: Distinctive bright LED signature in front bumper. Modernizes the car's face significantly.

lighting.name: Smoked/Tinted Taillights
lighting.real_world_ref: Smoked taillight film / OEM blackline taillights
